summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Woori Financial Group Inc., a Korean financial holding company, announcing the availability of its English-language 2025 Sustainability Report on its website. The filing contains no transaction, no special-situation event, and no material corporate action. It is purely a disclosure of a non-financial, voluntary sustainability report. There are no deal terms, no parties acting in an acquisition or divestiture capacity, and no regulatory or strategic event. Accordingly, the filing does not qualify as a special situation and is classified as 'None'.
